content.comment_body: Thank you so much! The manual you created with the assistance of [user_name] worked perfectly for me. I'm wondering if it's possible to open .lsc files directly from the iCloud folder. The issue is that [product_name] doesn't display the iCloud directory in its folder tree, so I have to manually copy .lsc and .UDF files to folders that [product_name] can access.

ChatGPT helped me solve the issue. Its solution was to: 1. Open Terminal on your Mac. 2. Run a command to create a symbolic link to your iCloud Drive in your home directory. 3. This creates a folder called iCloudDrive in your home directory, enabling access through the file browser in [product_name]. After following these steps, you should be able to reach your iCloud Drive from within the [product_name] application.

analysis.insight_summary: The user encountered a problem opening .lsc files from iCloud Drive because [product_name] did not display the iCloud folder in the application's file browser. This forced the user to move files manually to accessible directories, highlighting a usability issue related to integration between cloud storage services and application file access on MacOS.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to access cloud folders, such as iCloud Drive, directly within the [product_name] file picker on MacOS, allowing seamless integration between the application and cloud-based storage.
